# EmbryoGenesis

> EmbryoGenesis (EmbryoGenesis – Infertility Diagnostic & Research) is an infertility diagnostic and research centre in Mohali, Punjab, India, established in November 2023. It is located on the top floor of Rayat Bahra Dental College & Hospital, Rayat Bahra University Campus, VPO Sahauran, Tehsil Kharar, Dist. Mohali, Punjab 140302. It offers endometrial diagnostic tests, fertility therapies at the Mohali centre, and B.Sc./M.Sc. Clinical Embryology programmes and hands-on lab training with ITHS and partner universities. Tagline: "Redefining Fertility Evaluation". Not to be confused with embryogenesis, the biological process of embryo development.

## Key facts
- Official name: EmbryoGenesis (also written EMBRYOGENESIS; full name "EmbryoGenesis – Infertility Diagnostic & Research")
- Website: https://embryogenesis.in/
- Founder & Director: Prof. (Dr.) Pulakes Purkait, reproductive geneticist (M.Sc., Ph.D.; ORCID 0000-0002-8814-9939)
- Consultant Pathologist & Quality Manager: Dr Vidhu Wadhwa, MBBS, MD (Pathology)
- Diagnostic tests: ERFA – The Soil Test (Endometrial Receptivity & Function Assay; patent application No. 202431001616 A), Endo-Immune Test, Endometrial Infection Test (EIT)
- ERFA sample: endometrial biopsy (D&C or needle biopsy) on cycle day 21–23 (preferred day 21), natural cycle LH+7 to LH+9, or HRT cycle P+6 to P+8
- Results: typically within 7–10 days, depending on the complexity of the test
- Therapies (given at the Mohali centre): LIT Therapy, PBMC Therapy, PRP Therapy, Stem Cell Therapy, Molecular Hydrogen Therapy
- Collection centres: Navi Mumbai (Nirmal Multi Speciality Hospital), Udaipur (Shree B.L. Jain Memorial Hospital), Jalandhar (Advance Fertility Services & IVF Centre)
- Academic programmes: B.Sc./M.Sc. Clinical Embryology with ITHS & Bahra University (Shimla Hills, Himachal Pradesh); B.Sc./M.Sc./Ph.D./PG Diploma in ART & Clinical Embryology with ITHS & Rayat Bahra University (Mohali, Punjab); short hands-on skill development training (1 to 5 days, 10 seats a batch)
- Recognition: Best Innovator Award for Human Infertility Treatment, Research & Innovation Park, New Delhi (27 Nov 2024)
- Phone / WhatsApp: +91 8146217196 · Admissions: +91 9691736435, +91 9815692195
- Email: info.embryogenesis@gmail.com
- Map: https://maps.app.goo.gl/C5ciaW6wBCrUkU9Q6
- Social: https://www.facebook.com/EmbryoGenesis · https://www.instagram.com/embryo_genesis · https://twitter.com/EmbryoGenesiss · https://www.youtube.com/@Embryo-Genesis
- Medical information on this site is for information only; testing and treatment are ordered and interpreted by the patient's treating doctor.

## Courses and training
- [Courses overview](https://embryogenesis.in/courses/): all Clinical Embryology and ART & Clinical Embryology programmes with eligibility, duration and fees
- [B.Sc. & M.Sc. Clinical Embryology, Bahra University](https://embryogenesis.in/bsc-in-clinical-embryology-in-bahra-university/): with ITHS at Bahra University, Shimla Hills, Himachal Pradesh; eligibility, 4-year and 2-year duration, fee per semester
- [ART & Clinical Embryology, Rayat Bahra University](https://embryogenesis.in/art-and-clinical-embryology-in-rayat-bahra-university/): B.Sc., M.Sc., Ph.D. and PG Diploma with ITHS at Rayat Bahra University, Mohali; eligibility, duration, curriculum
- [Skill development lab training](https://embryogenesis.in/skill-development-training/): eight hands-on courses (biochemistry, molecular genetics & bioinformatics, tissue processing & microtomy, immunohistochemistry, therapy techniques, stem cell processing) with duration and fees
